application.name: AprilTag Detection
application.description: Detects AprilTags and estimates their 6-DoF poses with a choice of CPU, CUDA, or VPI (PVA) backends, through one reusable Holoscan 5 operator.

changelog.1.0.0: Initial release: AprilTagDetectorOp with cpu, cuda and vpi backends, synthetic and image-folder sources, Holoviz overlay.

hardware.name: NVIDIA GPU
hardware.description: A CUDA-capable GPU supported by the Holoscan SDK.

hardware.name: PVA
hardware.description: The Programmable Vision Accelerator of Jetson Orin or Thor, for the vpi-pva backend. Elsewhere VPI runs on the CPU.

synthetic.description: Detect tags in a rendered scene with every compiled backend, check them against ground truth, and display the first backend's detections when a display is available.

images.description: Detect tags in a folder of PGM/PPM images placed in the data directory. Add camera intrinsics with --run-args to also estimate poses.

benchmark.description: Run every compiled backend side by side on the same 300 synthetic frames, without a display, and print each one's latency.

ci.description: Finite headless check: 30 synthetic frames through every compiled backend, verified against ground truth.
